summary: Configured a 1 GiB LUKS1 encrypted volume on node1, automatically unlocked and mounted at /srv/secure on boot. Ubuntu 16.04.7 and kernel 4.4.0-210 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created a root-protected key and file-backed LUKS1 container.
Formatted the mapped volume as ext4 and mounted it at /srv/secure.
Configured /etc/crypttab and /etc/fstab for automatic boot unlock and mounting.
Verified a manual close and systemd-managed recovery cycle.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed automatic recovery with preserved test data.

evidence.summary: Shows the LUKS1 header, active dm-crypt mapping, ext4 filesystem, mount point, and successful systemd-managed reopen.

evidence.requirement: Automatic unlock and mount at boot
evidence.summary: Shows persistent crypttab/fstab configuration and current-boot logs proving systemd unlocked and mounted the volume automatically.
Before and after evidence shows Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS with kernel 4.4.0-210-generic and compatible LUKS1/cryptsetup operation.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 2f708738-0c85-418b-80df-7f976a17134d, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 5297ec91-ce2a-40c1-bdfd-40fea8048cd2, and recovered encryption service, mount, LUKS mapping, and stored data.
